title: Analyses manifest
description: One row per analysis OR registered obligation. An analysis is a comparison/finding OVER CONDITIONS (studies compare conditions, so the target is conditions_compared, not runs). This is where study findings live, and where preregistration linkage is recorded ('we did what we said, modulo errata'). Since vocabulary v2 (S134/D17, 2026-08-17) the register's semantics widened from 'analyses performed' to 'registered obligations and their dispositions': a registered-but-never-executed hypothesis carries a disposition row (preregistered: not-executed) so the manifest is the single source of truth for hypothesis disposition and the hypothesis-outcome table generates from it alone. Hybrid: the generator machine-fills analysis_id, output_path, working_notes_obs; humans author outcome, paper_section, and the prereg linkage. The generator never overwrites human-authored fields.

analysis_id.description: Primary key. Convention: the results/ subdir name (lowercased, hyphenated). For a top-level .md analysis, the filename stem.

type.description: 'disposition' (vocabulary v2) marks a registered-obligation row that records non-execution rather than a performed analysis; it pairs with preregistered: not-executed.

conditions_compared.description: Foreign keys to condition_id. CHANGED from the brief's runs_compared — studies compare conditions; the run/study are derivable from the conditions. Must be non-empty except on a not-executed disposition row, where it must be empty (enforced by the conditional below).

hypothesis_refs.description: HUMAN-authored. Controlled vocabulary: H1..H15 plus documented named programmes.

preregistered.description: HUMAN-authored preregistration status, vocabulary v2 (S134/D17 reconciliation, 2026-08-17). 'confirmatory': implements a registered confirmatory test (H1–H8) as registered, no material deviation. 'confirmatory-with-deviation': registered confirmatory test executed with disclosed deviations — cite the E-numbers in deviations. 'registered-exploratory': implements an analysis the preregistration registered as exploratory (H9–H15) or a registered characterisation/calibration step that carries no confirmatory claim. 'post-hoc': not in the registered analysis plan (post-hoc analyses are exploratory by definition). 'not-executed': a registered obligation never executed — a disposition row (type 'disposition', empty conditions_compared, deviations citing the disclosure erratum). null = not yet adjudicated. The v1 values ('preregistered', 'exploratory', 'preregistered-with-deviation') are retired and fail validation BY DESIGN, so no half-migrated register can ever be written.

deviations.description: HUMAN-authored. D-/E-numbers from decisions-log.md / protocol-errata.md (the 'modulo errata and amendments' demonstration).

predicted_outcome.description: HUMAN-authored. What the preregistration predicted, for the predicted-vs-actual comparison. WRITE-ONCE: once non-null, the generator refuses to overwrite it (a prediction is only evidence of foresight if it cannot be edited once the result is known). To change it legitimately, add predicted_outcome_amended.

predicted_outcome_amended.description: HUMAN-authored. The declared, auditable escape hatch from the write-once rule on predicted_outcome. Its presence permits the rewrite AND records it in the manifest, so an amended prediction is visibly amended rather than silently restated.

reason.description: Why the prediction changed. A result being known is NOT a reason.

date.description: ISO-8601 date on which the amendment was made.

previous.description: The EXACT superseded prediction as it stands on disk. Required, and checked: an amendment whose previous does not match the on-disk value is rejected, so an amendment supersedes one specific prediction rather than unlocking the field permanently.

tie_set.description: HUMAN-authored. Conditions found statistically indistinguishable (from a permutation/CI-overlap test). This is where a statistical tie is recorded — NOT by hard-coding a 'best' condition on the run.

output_path.description: results/<analysis_id>/ for a subdir analysis, or the path to a top-level .md file. A not-executed disposition row points at the document that discloses the non-execution (the unexecuted register or the erratum file) — there is no results artefact to point at.

manually_verified_at.description: Set when a human authors/verifies the row. The generator treats a non-null value as a signal not to overwrite the human-authored fields.

analysis.$comment: Lenient back-fill policy: the machine-fillable fields (analysis_id, type, conditions_compared, output_path, provenance) are required; all human-authored fields are nullable so a generator-created stub validates before a human authors it. The allOf conditional pairs not-executed with type 'disposition' and an empty conditions_compared; every other row (including preregistered: null stubs) must compare at least one condition.
